title: Join us on Friday, August 28th, 2026 for our next session of the Public Webinar Series!
summary: The CFDE Training Center will showcase their Outcomes and Opportunities.
bodyHtml:
🧬 CFDE Training Center: Outcomes and Opportunities

📣 Join this session to:

  1. Learn about the impact of the CFDE Training Center, including podcasts, workshops, and e-Learning modules.
  2. Learn about upcoming training and engagement opportunities.
  3. Provide input on desired topics and formats for future training.

📆 August 28, 2026

⏰ 1-2 PM ET

🎙️ Speakers:

  • Laurel Brown, MBA, PMP: Training Lead
  • Kelli Bursey, MPH, CHES: Evaluation Lead

🔗 Explore https://www.orau.org/cfde-trainingcenter/index.html
